workarounds.symptom: worktree: advertised native child creation produces an unresumable delegate
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(agent): parent-only non-destructive delegate lane unlock (#481). Target files: agent/delegate_lane_handoff.go, agent/delegate_lane_unlock.go, agent/delegate_tree_controller.go.
